cardOverview.overviewText: An entry-level Instant Platinum card providing simple rewards on everyday purchases, milestone benefits, and affordability for first-time credit users.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary EazyDiner Prime with Premium Plan.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Download the EazyDiner Application.|Sign up for new customers or login for existing customer. using the registered mobile number with Axis Bank.|Select 12-Month EazyDiner Prime Membership plan and click on Pay Now.|Prime membership will be available to buy at a payment of ₹1 for eligible mobile numbers.
